name: coding-read-and-explain-function
description: Code comprehension: read a function and explain what it does, identify edge cases

turns.userMessage: Explain what the parseQuery function does and identify all potential edge cases.

mockResponses.text: The `parseQuery` function parses a raw input string into a structured Query object. **Edge cases**: (1) empty string throws, (2) whitespace-only input throws after trim but before split, (3) single-word input produces empty args array, (4) leading/trailing whitespace is handled by trim(), (5) multiple consecutive spaces are collapsed by regex split.
